headline: Weather Alert: Maritime ports asked to hoist cautionary signal No 3
summary: Authorities have issued a warning for maritime ports to signal caution as weather conditions deteriorate.
details: Maritime ports in Bangladesh have been instructed to hoist cautionary signal No 3.
This measure is part of a weather warning issued to ensure the safety of ships and vessels in the maritime regions.
Port authorities are on high alert to manage potential risks associated with the weather conditions.
Vessels are advised to take necessary precautions to avoid any accidents at sea.

headline: Heavy rains push up vegetable, fish prices in Gopalganj
summary: Recent inclement weather has led to a surge in the cost of essential food items, affecting local consumers.
details: Heavy rainfall in Gopalganj has caused a significant increase in the price of vegetables and fish.
The weather conditions have disrupted supply chains and affected crop yields, leading to higher market rates.
Local consumers are facing difficulties as the cost of daily essentials continues to rise.
Authorities are monitoring the situation to ensure market stability and prevent unfair price hikes.
